invariants.rationale: Method expects a non-null list of prepped records; null would likely cause failure or be checked elsewhere.
instantTime represents a commit or instant identifier and is expected to be a non-empty string.
bulkInsertPartitioner is an Option, which is typically not null but may be empty; null would likely be a bug.
Bulk insert operations are typically performed on non-empty record lists.
bulkInsertPartitioner is an Option, so it must be either present or not present, but this is tautological and might be removed depending on context.
